format: C++/Objective-C++ (likely a mixture for Metal APIs and native C++)
description: This source file contains implementations of advanced linear algebra operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for matrix multiplication, batched operations, LU decomposition, solving linear systems, Cholesky factorization, and QR decomposition, leveraging MPS APIs to utilize GPU acceleration on Apple hardware.

classes.name: AlphaBeta
classes.description: Union used to store scalar alpha and beta values in different types for Metal kernel operations.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: Template class for caching MPS graph computations to avoid recreating graphs for similar operations.

methods.name: make_alpha_beta
methods.description: Creates an AlphaBeta union instance populated with alpha and beta values cast to the appropriate type based on scalar_type.
